purpose: Persist documented, mathematically reproducible gambling advantage mechanisms and convert them into EDGE model requirements without treating anecdotes or cross-market formulas as current Spain execution evidence.

methods.documentedMechanism: For a genuine MHB progressive with a known maximum, meter-rise rate and verified trigger distribution, a sufficiently high meter can make the marginal wager positive expectation.

edgeApplication: Ultimate Video Poker Spain is a high-value lane because exact paytable plus exact qualifying stake plus royal probability makes EV directly computable

methods.documentedMechanism: A persistent collection meter with a must-hit-by endpoint can become positive when left by a previous player sufficiently advanced toward its trigger.
edgeApplication: Expand Spain catalog search beyond monetary jackpots to persistent collect meters, guaranteed-state bonuses and banked features

edgeApplication: Systematically search DGOJ resolutions and attached technical documents by operator/provider/game family

selectionPrinciple: EDGE prioritizes exploitable state: known cap/seed, state-dependent hazard, persistent state, exact progressive paytable, or another rule that changes conditional EV. Ordinary independent RNG spin-history patterns are not an advantage method.
